name: auto-jobs
description: A Playwright V1 runner for Jenkins-rendered SonarQube and Snyk vulnerability reports.

scripts.test:report: node scripts/run-playwright.mjs --env PLAYWRIGHT_REPORT_ONLY=1 playwright test tests/e2e/generated-report.spec.ts --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:release: npm run typecheck &&  npm run build &&  npm run test:unit &&  npm run test:e2e:templates &&  npm run test:report &&  npm run test:release:webkit
scripts.test:e2e:templates: node scripts/run-playwright.mjs --env PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS=false --env PLAYWRIGHT_SLOW_MO=500 playwright test tests/e2e/template-navigation.spec.ts --config=playwright.template.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/run-playwright.mjs --env PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS=false --env PLAYWRIGHT_SLOW_MO=500 playwright test tests/e2e/vendor-template-capture.spec.ts tests/e2e/multi-project-report-flow.spec.ts --config=playwright.config.ts --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test: npm run typecheck &&  npm run test:unit &&  npm run test:e2e
